name: Cholera & mosquito-borne
value: Cholera in DRC; record dengue seasons
summary: Cholera spikes in DR Congo; record dengue in Florida and Bangladesh
state: UN agencies report cholera cases spiking in DR Congo alongside the Ebola response (October), and the Central African Republic has declared a cholera outbreak. Florida's dengue outbreak is the largest in a US state in decades, and Bangladesh's dengue death toll is still rising. No WHO grade 3 declaration as of 1 Nov.
for_you: Use mosquito protection when travelling to dengue-affected regions; check TravelHealthPro before travel.
rubric_hit: Record-level seasons, or local transmission in countries where the disease was not established (including Europe).

sources.title: UN News — Cholera spikes in DR Congo

EMPHNET — Central African Republic declares cholera outbreak

why: Climate-sensitive diseases — cholera, dengue, chikungunya, Oropouche, West Nile and yellow fever — are hitting record levels and reaching new regions.
drivers: Conflict, floods, heat, El Niño, water and sanitation, mosquito range expansion.

rubric.alert: Large outbreaks with high mortality in conflict zones, or a WHO grade 3 emergency.
rubric.watch: Record-level seasons, or local transmission in countries where the disease was not established (including Europe).
